Scenario fixture: canvas-text-alternative-present

This file intentionally includes edge cases to test eligibility and rule outcomes. Each test canvas has a stable id of the form canvas_case_XX.

A. Baseline (eligible)

01 — FAIL: visible <canvas> with no fallback and no name
Missing fallback and accessible name.
02 — PASS: fallback text present
Chart summary Fallback text provides a text alternative.
03 — PASS: aria-label provides accessible name
Accessible name via aria-label.
04 — PASS: aria-labelledby provides accessible name
Revenue chart
Accessible name via aria-labelledby.
05 — PASS: title attribute used as name (helper subset)
Accessible name via title attribute (helper supports title fallback).
06 — FAIL: label[for] does not provide a name (canvas is not labelable)
No browser computes an accessible name for <canvas> from a native <label for> association.
Native <label> is not a recognized text-alternative mechanism for <canvas>.

B. aria-hidden / eligibility exceptions

07 — INELIGIBLE: aria-hidden true and not tabbable
Ineligible; should not contribute to pass/fail.
08 — INELIGIBLE: display:none
Ineligible per helper.
09 — INELIGIBLE: inert ancestor
Ineligible due to inertness.
10 — INELIGIBLE: aria-hidden but tabbable (tabindex=0), no text alternative
Hidden regardless of focusability; aria-hidden-focus reports it instead.
16 — INELIGIBLE: aria-hidden but tabindex=-1 (programmatic focus only)
Programmatic focus does not override aria-hidden eligibility in helper.
17 — PASS: IDREF-referenced aria-hidden canvas is eligible and has name
Host
IDREF override makes canvas eligible; it passes due to aria-label.
20 — INELIGIBLE: IDREF-referenced aria-hidden canvas
Host
An IDREF reference names the host; it does not put the canvas back in the tree.

C. Conditions that should NOT exclude eligibility

11 — FAIL: opacity:0, no text alternative
Opacity does not exclude eligibility per engine guardrails.
12 — FAIL: offscreen, no text alternative
Offscreen does not exclude eligibility per engine guardrails.
13 — FAIL: zero-size container, no text alternative
Zero-size does not exclude eligibility per engine guardrails.

D. Non-composed content

14 — INELIGIBLE: inside <template>
Template content is not composed; should be ineligible.

E. Closed details

18 — INELIGIBLE: in closed <details>
Summary
Helper treats content in closed details as ineligible.

F. visibility:hidden

19 — INELIGIBLE: visibility:hidden ancestor
Ineligible per helper (visibility hidden).

G. Aggregation / whole-rule behavior

15 — PASS candidate: eligible canvas passes; ineligible canvas should not fail
Eligible passes, ineligible is ignored.
21 — FAIL: tabbable canvas (tabindex=0) without fallback/name
Tabbable canvas is eligible and must provide a text alternative.

H. Descendant fallback content (img[alt] / area[alt] / [aria-label])

22 — PASS: fallback via descendant <img alt> (no direct text)
A descendant <img> with non-empty alt counts as meaningful canvas fallback content.
23 — FAIL: descendant <img alt=""> (empty alt does not count)
Empty alt on the descendant image is not meaningful fallback content.
24 — PASS: fallback via descendant <area alt>
A descendant <area> with non-empty alt counts as meaningful canvas fallback content.
25 — PASS: fallback via descendant [aria-label]
Any descendant with a non-empty aria-label counts as meaningful canvas fallback content.

End of fixture.
